verdict.rationale: LightSprint is a SaaS development platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a public API or a downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent spec, and a probe of the standard OpenAPI paths on its docs site returned 404 for every candidate. The MCP integrations, Slack/Linear/Jira sync and GitHub-backed delivery are adjacent features and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
